title: PGP-1.03 memev: engine decision recorded, tier docs aligned, README rewritten, reconciliation against the work breakdown
request: Per-pull-request contract for memev, branch docs/engine-decision-tiers-reconcile. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs after the red-team gate. Repository: memev. Documents only: no src/ change, no change to docs/scope-one/WBS.md, to any SO-1.x contract, signature or red-team record. RECONCILIATION.md refers to docs/scope-one/WBS.md and to SO-1.02 (reconciliation) and does not restate them. Programme tasks covered: WP16-03 (memev side), WP15-02 (memev side), WP17-05 and the live-inventory step of WP17-01; the rest of WP08-01, WP17-01 and WP17-02 is SO-1.02 and docs/scope-one/WBS.md. Boundary with SO-2.13 and SO-2.14: these pages keep the tier names, prices, licences and the open-core boundary statement; multi-person project permissions and team administration (SO-2.14) and the commercial service boundary (SO-2.13) are not written here. Boundary with SO-A-11 (signed fold contract, cited by id; pull request #341): it owns the script scripts/register-check.mjs that checks the register and the inventory; this contract writes the reconciliation pages by hand, builds no checker, and the script is run over these pages when it lands. Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply (the engine decision confirmed by the owner, t542u): crdt-merge stays in its own repository (BSL 1.1 with its PATENTS file) and is reached only across the call-out boundary, never vendored, so inclusion cannot relicense it; tiers are the free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that, with no Federated tier and no separate Personal trial; federation is planned, not available. Depends on contracts: SO-1.02. Signed vault contract WO-05-E (cited by id only): the licence boundary text guard; this contract states the licences once and does not weaken it. Signed vault contract MEM-064, MEM-065, MEM-066, MEM-137 and REV-032 (cited by id only): their price and tier values are superseded by the owner decision of 31 Oct 2026, which this contract applies.
